comments.content: Coalescing purely by `flags` equality is unsafe: two different options can share the same UPDATE_* flag but have different `co`/`opt_ptr`. Dropping one because it has the same flags as another would skip an option-specific action keyed on `opt_ptr` (e.g. `opts->ipc_path` vs `opts->play_dir`). Coalescing should only drop when the same option (`co->data`) is queued, not when flags merely match.

Now that IPC init is moved out of the option-change callback path and initialized explicitly here, confirm the previous `init` code path (which formerly reinitialized IPC on startup via `mp_option_change_callback` with `co == NULL`) is no longer relied upon elsewhere. The `init` handling was removed from the callback, so any startup-only actions that used to run under `if (init ...)` must be verified to still execute.
